description: Use this when preparing stage 2. action build: AI proposes the concept blocks and saves them (save: false to only look); it runs as a job and answers at once, so wait with revisia_jobs (kind strategy) and call build again to get the proposal without new AI. action toggle_block: put a concept block in the query or take it out (comparator and outcome start out on purpose: requiring them narrows the search); without terms it switches on revisia's suggested names. action toggle_term: switch names on or off. action edit_strategy / edit_queries: save the researcher's changes; edit_strategy replaces every block, so send back status detail full blocks with their provenance. action run: run searches in the databases the researcher chose (providers, or searches); without them it launches nothing and returns the available databases so you can ask. dry_run defaults to true and only reports the counts, dry_run false launches ingestion jobs. action import: import an exported reference file (RIS, BibTeX, CSV, NBIB, WoS, ICTRP) by passing its CONTENT, at most 200,000 characters per call (split a bigger file into several imports); URLs are never fetched. Wait for jobs with revisia_jobs.

active.description: toggle_block: in the query (AND) or out.

block.description: toggle_block, toggle_term: block role or label.

blocks.description: edit_strategy: every concept block, as in strategy_blocks of status detail full.

provenance.description: Copy back unchanged from status detail full.

content.description: import: the file CONTENT (RIS, BibTeX, CSV, NBIB/MEDLINE, WoS or ICTRP export), at most 200,000 characters per call: split a bigger file into several imports. Never a URL.

dry_run.description: Default true: only report what would run and the quota used. false launches.

enabled.description: toggle_term: switch the names on or off.

format.description: import: file format (auto-detected if left out).

idempotency_key.description: Same key within 24 h returns the first launch instead of a second job.

providers.description: run: databases to search with the saved strategy, only the ones the researcher chose. Leave out to get the list to ask them.

save.description: build: save the proposed strategy (default true). The researcher still signs stage 2.

searches.description: run: searches to launch. Leave out to use the saved strategy's query for each database in `providers`.

source.description: import: database the file was exported from, for PRISMA.

terms.description: toggle_term: names to switch (source tells MeSH from free text). toggle_block active true: names to search with; omit for revisia's suggestions.

name: revisia_search_act
title: Build, run and import searches
